name: Xmind
author: Xmind Ltd.
summary: A full-featured Swiss Army Knife for your brain.
description: The full-featured mind mapping and brainstorming app. Like a Swiss Army Knife, Xmind offers a complete toolset for thinking and creativity.

versions.release_notes:
1. Fixed an issue where clearing task duration caused errors.
2. Fixed an issue with formula display errors.
3. Fixed an issue where some keyboard shortcuts didn't work in Outliner.
4. Fixed an issue with inserting elements in Outliner.
5. Fixed other known issues.

Important Updates
1. Zone: Organize map content. Group related floating topics for easier layout, selection, and export.
2. Skip Non-working Days: Plan by working days. Automatically skip non-working days when calculating project timelines.
3. Gantt Enhancements: More efficient large-scale scheduling. Link tasks in bulk, adjust timelines with fewer actions.
Improvements
1. Added support for British English.
2. Gantt chart supports multi-selecting tasks to quickly add dependencies.
3. Gantt chart supports exporting to PNG, JPEG, and PDF.
4. Gantt chart supports printing.
5. Gantt chart supports quick editing of start date and duration.
6. Adding dependencies no longer requires setting start and end dates.
7. Supports customizing the start day of the week.
8. Optimized display logic when pasting externally copied content into mind maps.
9. Fixed an issue with line breaks in main topics in logic charts.
10. Fixed an issue with abnormal branch export.
11. Fixed an issue where English punctuation marks displayed in the wrong position in Arabic text.
12. Fixed an issue where exporting Markdown tasks showed a failure message.
13. Fixed other known issues.Claude is AI and can make mistakes. Please double-check responses.
Fixed some known issues.

1. Optimized the display position of the label on the topic in the Grid structure.
2. Improved the reconnection experience when online mind maps get disconnected.
3. Fixed an issue where some relationship line shapes could not be used.
4. Fixed an incompatibility issue between topic content width and task display.
5. Fixed an issue where rich text formatting was lost after copying and pasting.
6. Fixed a layout overflow issue in the Tree Table when labels and images were present.
7. Fixed a layout overflow issue in the Grid structure when labels were present.
8. Fixed an issue where copying styles did not work after updating a topic style.
9. Fixed a display issue in the Custom Style interface.
10. Fixed other known issues.

Important Updates
1. Gantt Chart - Plan with timelines. Drag bars to update progress and link tasks to create dependencies.
2. AI-Generated Mind Maps - Automatically turn any text, links, or documents into mind maps, or break them into tasks and to-dos.
3. Better Markdown Parsing - More reliable import and export with improved handling of tables, text styles, lists, and more.
Improvements
1. Task now support adding assignees and dependencies.
2. Task date formats automatically adapt to the app language.
3. Optimized date selection interaction for tasks.
4. Supported exporting tasks to CSV and Calendar (ICS) formats.
5. Exported branch now supports more formats.
6. Supported automatic parsing when pasting Markdown text.
7. Fixed an issue where collaborative files couldn’t filter tasks.
8. Fixed an issue where exporting specific files to Word failed.
9. Fixed other known issues.
